ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate the central 90% of the visible surface area, bordered by a thin perimeter of low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white block across both lobes; low-intensity dark band along the trailing edge; single isolated dark pixel cluster located in the mid-left lobe; dark mottled region on the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth extends approximately 15-20% into the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous linear boundary; right lobe displays sharper, deeper peaks and valleys (sawtooth pattern) compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave upward curve originating from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters observed on the extreme distal tips and on the summits of several trailing edge peaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue loss and deep indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe, exceeding the amplitude of standard serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific sequence and spacing of high-amplitude 'teeth' on the trailing edge create a unique geometric profile.
